observer_root_cause: Repeat/prewarming enables multiple actual video renderers. The single public videoDecoderCounters reference is replaced onVideoEnabled and cleared onVideoDisabled; it is not a stable total of all active rendered output.
fix: Debug observer retains actual AnalyticsListener.onVideoEnabled counters per player identity and totals their rendered output; first-frame callback, compositor, 60s wall clock, controls and release gates remain mandatory. No production prewarming setting is disabled.
